description: The IAM identities of the people who operate this system. The quarantine responder (scripts/_quarantine.py) never quarantines them: a reportable finding that names one is paged about only. infrastructure/bootstrap/quarantine-responder.tf reads this same file into the responder's explicit IAM Deny, so a code bug cannot reach them either. Not published: user names never appear in /.well-known, the SDR, views or drill records.
rationale: AI-drafted (Claude, 2026-11-06) for the operator's review. Who is an operator is listed, not inferred: the operator's user has no console login profile, so a login-profile test would treat it as a machine user, and anyone holding its key could delete a login profile anyway. The list holds the operator user the bootstrap stack already names; add any other person's IAM user here, and the Deny follows on the next bootstrap apply.
